title: Style panel: presets first, the levers under "More"
recommendation: Show the six presets and one "More" disclosure holding Fonts, Background, Size, Corners and the page accent colour; take logo and logo alignment off the panel; keep the lever architecture as blessed in July.

questions.q: Keep Size and Corners (under More) or delete them from the panel as the audit proposed?
questions.recommended: Keep them under More. The lever system is the architecture; hiding costs nothing, deleting reopens a settled design.

questions.q: Does the page accent colour stay per page (under More, defaulting to the brand colour) or become Settings-only?
questions.recommended: Per page under More. 44 of 288 recent pages use a non-default colour, and the brand-colour setting is filled on only 16 workspaces today.

questions.q: Logo off the panel entirely (canvas "+ Add logo" and Settings only)?
questions.recommended: Yes. U18 already reduces the three logo prompts to Settings plus one in-editor ask; the panel checkbox is the one to lose.
